items.title: Continuum-AI-Corp/OrcaReplay — OrcaReplay — Time travel for AI agents. Record, replay, fork, and debug any agent run with any model. Built by
items.one_liner: Use OrcaReplay to capture, offline-replay, and model-fork AI agent executions at the process and socket boundary.
items.summary: OrcaReplay is an open-source tool and proxy system designed to record, replay, fork, and debug AI agent runs byte-for-byte with the network disabled. Operating at the process and socket boundary, it captures execution data regardless of whether the user can edit the agent code or whether the agent utilizes base-URL configuration variables. By standing up a local proxy and monitoring streams, timings, and shadow git indexes, the tool lets developers fork an agent session at any step onto a different model to evaluate performance variations.
items.bottom_line: Debugging AI agents requires capturing full execution streams below the application layer to enable deterministic replay and model forking.

claims.text: Record any coding agent. Reproduce the run byte-for-byte with the network off. Fork it from any step onto a different model and see who gets it right.
claims.support_span: Record any coding agent. Reproduce the run byte-for-byte with the network off. Fork it from any step onto a different model and see who gets it right.

claims.text: Capture happens below the agent — at the process and socket boundary — so it does not matter whether the agent is yours...

claims.text:
简体中文 · English
  你的私人、持续进化的社媒运营助手
  从一个想法开始，完成发现、策划、创作、发布与复盘。
Easel 是一个面向社交媒体创作者的开源内容工作台。它把 OpenClaw Agent、账号画像、内容技能和真实的媒体工具接在一起，让 Agent 不只回答“应该怎么做”，而是直接把内容做出来并归档，且可实现直接/按需发布。
你可以把它理解成一个会记住你的内容搭档：它了解账号定位、受众、风格、平台限制和历史表现，从热点发现一直陪你做到发布，再把结果带回下一次创作。
Easel 围绕五个连续工作流展开：发现适合账号的热点与机会，策划选题、标题、脚本和排期， 创作图文、音频与视频内容，发布经过检查和平台适配的成品直接到对应平台，再通过归因分析表现并把有效经验沉淀回账号画像。
- 推荐使用 Web 前端：前端提供完整的会话、素材、账号、画像、内容库和发布管理能力，体验和功能比单独使用 CLI 更全面。
- 谨慎自动发布到小红书：小红书平台可能检测自动化操作，存在验证、限流或账号风控风险；建议使用预览与发布前检查，并由用户确认后手动发布，其他平台正常。
- 从研究走向真实生活：Easel 是我们将研究成果应用到真实社媒创作场景的一次实践。后续我们会继续研究 AI 在社媒场景中的社交智能，让 Agent 更好地理解创作者、受众与真实互动。
- 一个 Agent 贯穿完整链路：发现热点、评估选题、规划日历、生成文案与视觉、制作视频、发布和归因在同一个工作流中完成。
- 画像驱动，而不是一次性生成：每个账号有独立的定位、风格、受众、平台、偏好和记忆，输出会越来越贴合真实账号。
- 技能是真执行，不是功能清单：图片、卡片、配音、字幕、剪辑、短剧和发布技能都配有可运行脚本，成品写入 outputs/ 。
- 一份素材，多种平台形态：同一主题可以改写成小红书卡片、短视频、知乎长文或短帖，并遵循不同平台的格式和字数要求。
- 项目化保存产物：内容、素材、中间文件和元数据按项目归档，后续修改、重试和发布不会散落在聊天记录里。
- 真实发布与复盘闭环：目前支持小红书、抖音、快手、知乎、B 站、微信视频号六个平台的登录、适配和发布，并可回收账号数据。
- 发现：聚合热榜、行业新闻、竞品动态和用户讨论，筛选真正适合账号的机会。
- 策划：把机会变成选题、标题、脚本和内容矩阵，写入内容日历。
- 创作：生成文案、卡片、海报、信息图、音频、视频、短剧和论文解读等可发布素材。
- 发布：按平台适配标题、正文、画幅和媒体要求，执行发布前检查并发送到已登录账号。
- 归因：读取播放、互动、评论和内容表现，把有效结构和偏好沉淀回账号画像。
下面只展示 Easel 工作台中的四个代表性功能，并不是完整功能清单。更多发现、策划、创作、发布和归因能力， 可以在工作台的技能库或能力地图中查看。
这些文件来自 Easel 的实际工作流，主页中也有同一批案例的分类展示。

环境要求：Linux 或 macOS、Python 3.10 及以上、git。还需要 Node.js 22.19 及以上；Linux x86_64
缺少 Node.js 时安装脚本会自动处理，macOS 建议先通过 Homebrew 或 Node.js 官网安装。
git clone git@github.com:ZJU-REAL/Easel.git
cd Easel
cp .env.example .env
vim .env
bash setup.sh
easel web
# 或：easel chat
启动 Web 工作台后访问 http://localhost:7860。安装完成后可以运行 easel doctor 检查环境，
运行 easel ping 检查 gateway 和 Agent 连通性。
需要图片、音视频或浏览器发布能力时，安装可选依赖：
pip install -e ".[media]"
playwright install chromium
# 系统还需要 ffmpeg
最小配置只需要在项目根目录 .env 中提供一个可用的 LLM：
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=你的_API_Key
CLAUDE_MODEL=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6
.env.example 还列出了视频、音乐、语音等可选模型配置。只需要配置实际使用的能力，也可以在 Web
工作台的“技能库”中填写；没有配置的媒体 Skill 不会影响聊天、策划和文本创作。常见可选项包括：
常用入口：
所有技能都通过 Easel 的 Agent 执行。Agent 会读取对应 SKILL.md，调用脚本和工具，并把产物保存到 outputs/。
easel skill quality-gate -i "帮我检查这条小红书文案"
easel skill social-content -i "写一条介绍空间智能的微博"
easel skill quality-gate -i "这是一段待发布文案" -p 科技数码达人
Web 工作台提供同样的能力，并额外管理会话、素材、账号、画像、内容库和发布状态。拖入对话框的素材会作为结构化附件传给 Agent，用户消息只显示实际输入的文字。
一个画像对应 profiles/<名字>/ 目录，包含六个维度：定位、风格、受众、平台、偏好与红线、长期记忆。
cp -r profiles/_template "profiles/我的账号"
在 Web 的“画像”页面可以直接创建和编辑；同一画像可以跨多个已登录平台使用。
Easel/
├── easel/                    Python CLI：chat / web / skill / doctor / ping
├── web/                      FastAPI 后端与 React 工作台
├── skills/openclaw/          发现、策划、制作、发布、归因技能
├── skills/shared/            跨技能脚本与参考资料
├── assets/                   品牌、README 媒体与用户导入素材
├── profiles/                 账号画像（每个画像一个目录）
├── outputs/                  内容项目与最终产物
├── openclaw/                 隔离 profile、workspace 与同步脚本
└── docs/                     能力规范、能力地图与架构文档
Easel 使用独立的 easel OpenClaw profile，不会覆盖你本机已有的 OpenClaw 配置。Web 默认运行在 7860，gateway 默认运行在 18789。
Easel 的技能体系和工作流受益于许多优秀的开源项目、工具与内容方法论。感谢所有原作者和社区贡献者； 具体项目、用途和许可信息请查看完整致谢。

Easel 围绕五个连续工作流展开：发现适合账号的热点与机会，策划选题、标题、脚本和排期， 创作图文、音频与视频内容，发布经过检查和平台适配的成品直接到对应平台，再通过归因分析表现并把有效经验沉淀回账号画像。
- 推荐使用 Web 前端：前端提供完整的会话、素材、账号、画像、内容库和发布管理能力，体验和功能比单独使用 CLI 更全面。
- 谨慎自动发布到小红书：小红书平台可能检测自动化操作，存在验证、限流或账号风控风险；建议使用预览与发布前检查，并由用户确认后手动发布，其他平台正常。
- 从研究走向真实生活：Easel 是我们将研究成果应用到真实社媒创作场景的一次实践。后续我们会继续研究 AI 在社媒场景中的社交智能，让 Agent 更好地理解创作者、受众与真实互动。
- 一个 Agent 贯穿完整链路：发现热点、评估选题、规划日历、生成文案与视觉、制作视频、发布和归因在同一个工作流中完成。
- 画像驱动，而不是一次性生成：每个账号有独立的定位、风格、受众、平台、偏好和记忆，输出会越来越贴合真实账号。
- 技能是真执行，不是功能清单：图片、卡片、配音、字幕、剪辑、短剧和发布技能都配有可运行脚本，成品写入 outputs/ 。
- 一份素材，多种平台形态：同一主题可以改写成小红书卡片、短视频、知乎长文或短帖，并遵循不同平台的格式和字数要求。
- 项目化保存产物：内容、素材、中间文件和元数据按项目归档，后续修改、重试和发布不会散落在聊天记录里。
- 真实发布与复盘闭环：目前支持小红书、抖音、快手、知乎、B 站、微信视频号六个平台的登录、适配和发布，并可回收账号数据。
- 发现：聚合热榜、行业新闻、竞品动态和用户讨论，筛选真正适合账号的机会。
- 策划：把机会变成选题、标题、脚本和内容矩阵，写入内容日历。
- 创作：生成文案、卡片、海报、信息图、音频、视频、短剧和论文解读等可发布素材。
- 发布：按平台适配标题、正文、画幅和媒体要求，执行发布前检查并发送到已登录账号。
- 归因：读取播放、互动、评论和内容表现，把有效结构和偏好沉淀回账号画像。
下面只展示 Easel 工作台中的四个代表性功能，并不是完整功能清单。更多发现、策划、创作、发布和归因能力， 可以在工作台的技能库或能力地图中查看。

环境要求：Linux 或 macOS、Python 3.10 及以上、git。还需要 Node.js 22.19 及以上；Linux x86_64
缺少 Node.js 时安装脚本会自动处理，macOS 建议先通过 Homebrew 或 Node.js 官网安装。
git clone git@github.com:ZJU-REAL/Easel.git
cd Easel
cp .env.example .env
vim .env
bash setup.sh
easel web
# 或：easel chat
启动 Web 工作台后访问 http://localhost:7860。安装完成后可以运行 easel doctor 检查环境，
运行 easel ping 检查 gateway 和 Agent 连通性。
需要图片、音视频或浏览器发布能力时，安装可选依赖：
pip install -e ".[media]"
playwright install chromium
# 系统还需要 ffmpeg

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=你的_API_Key

.env.example 还列出了视频、音乐、语音等可选模型配置。只需要配置实际使用的能力，也可以在 Web
工作台的“技能库”中填写；没有配置的媒体 Skill 不会影响聊天、策划和文本创作。常见可选项包括：
常用入口：
所有技能都通过 Easel 的 Agent 执行。Agent 会读取对应 SKILL.md，调用脚本和工具，并把产物保存到 outputs/。
easel skill quality-gate -i "帮我检查这条小红书文案"
easel skill social-content -i "写一条介绍空间智能的微博"
easel skill quality-gate -i "这是一段待发布文案" -p 科技数码达人
Web 工作台提供同样的能力，并额外管理会话、素材、账号、画像、内容库和发布状态。拖入对话框的素材会作为结构化附件传给 Agent，用户消息只显示实际输入的文字。
一个画像对应 profiles/<名字>/ 目录，包含六个维度：定位、风格、受众、平台、偏好与红线、长期记忆。
cp -r profiles/_template "profiles/我的账号"
在 Web 的“画像”页面可以直接创建和编辑；同一画像可以跨多个已登录平台使用。

├── easel/                    Python CLI：chat / web / skill / doctor / ping
├── web/                      FastAPI 后端与 React 工作台
├── skills/openclaw/          发现、策划、制作、发布、归因技能

├── assets/                   品牌、README 媒体与用户导入素材

Easel 使用独立的 easel OpenClaw profile，不会覆盖你本机已有的 OpenClaw 配置。Web 默认运行在 7860，gateway 默认运行在 18789。
Easel 的技能体系和工作流受益于许多优秀的开源项目、工具与内容方法论。感谢所有原作者和社区贡献者； 具体项目、用途和许可信息请查看完整致谢。

items.title: Agentic Settlement Protocol: An Application Profile for Refundable, Delayed-Fulfilment Agent Commerce on Stablecoin Rails
items.one_liner: The Agentic Settlement Protocol brings escrow-based authorize-and-capture commerce to autonomous agents on stablecoin rails.
items.summary: Autonomous agents can already pay per request through protocols like x402, but atomic and final transactions fail in agent commerce where delayed fulfillment requires escrow. The Agentic Settlement Protocol (ASP) introduces an application profile over on-chain authorize-and-capture escrow for businesses whose fulfillment is confirmed off-chain. ASP provides a three-deadline hold model, a fulfillment-verification ladder, engine-authoritative partial refunds, and exposure controls to bound credit risk on stablecoin rails. The design is intended to let independent implementations interoperate and is instantiated on the XDC Network.
items.bottom_line: Autonomous agent commerce requires delayed-fulfillment escrow models rather than atomic per-request payments to safely handle real-world transactions.

claims.text: Autonomous agents can already pay per request: HTTP-native protocols such as x402 let an agent sign a stablecoin authorization and receive a resource in the same round trip.

items.title: SCX Router: Streaming Zero-Shot Model Selection with a Decoder-KV Classifier and a Real-World Task Ontology
items.one_liner: Deploy SCX Router for zero-shot LLM model selection using a persistent key-value cache and a 0.6B Qwen3 decoder.
items.summary: Researchers introduce SCX Router, a lightweight 0.6B-parameter model selection router combining a Qwen3 decoder with a shallow bidirectional scorer to assign suitability scores to inference-time models without autoregressive generation. The architecture preserves a text-only key-value cache across sessions while evaluating transient candidate-label tokens independently. Trained on a massive synthetically generated task ontology containing 150,000 verifier-scored tasks, the router predicts task type, difficulty, and reasoning mode while optimizing cost, speed, and quality tradeoffs. Across evaluation sets, the approach outperforms the mean candidate and achieves strong aggregate top-1 performance compared to fixed models.
items.bottom_line: Per-task model selection can be efficiently automated using lightweight specialized routers without autoregressive generation overhead.

items.title: SkillGLoW: Procedural-Family Skill Consolidation for Self-Improving Agents on Long-Horizon Task Streams
items.one_liner: Consolidate agent skills into procedural-family global priors with rigorous commit gates for continual improvement.
items.summary: SkillGLoW is a skill consolidation framework designed for self-improving LLM agents working on long-horizon task streams where traditional global documents or flat pools fail. The system aggregates local skills executed during individual tasks into procedural families, compressing them into de-instantiated global priors while regenerating specific instance details dynamically per task. A strict commit gate admits a prior only if real execution proves it enhances the deployed library. Experiments across four benchmarks show that SkillGLoW significantly outperforms baselines while maintaining a compact library size.
key_facts: Score gain: 17.2 points (hard) over no-skill baseline
Benchmarks tested: 4 (mathematical reasoning, terminal automation, software repair, embodied control)
Library compactness: 3.6x more compact than per-task pool
items.bottom_line: Transferring procedural methods rather than task-specific memory enables robust continual skill improvement for autonomous agents.

items.title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting
items.one_liner: Loom aggregates noisy diagnostic hypotheses into a rapid, consensus-driven Root Cause Analysis framework using embedding-space reweighting.
items.summary: Loom is a generative consensus framework for real-world Root Cause Analysis that aggregates open-form hypotheses emitted by modular diagnostic heuristics. By projecting textual hypotheses into a continuous embedding space and resolving conflicts via an iterative centroid-based reweighting algorithm, Loom feeds a single lightweight LLM synthesis step. Evaluations on the OpenRCA benchmark show that Loom matches state-of-the-art autonomous agents on multiple datasets while operating roughly 26 times faster with a single LLM call per incident. This deterministic consensus approach reduces inference latency and fosters trust among subject matter experts.
key_facts: Speedup factor: ~26x faster than state-of-the-art agents
items.bottom_line: Loom accelerates root cause analysis by replacing expensive multi-turn agent loops with an embedding-space centroid consensus feeding a single LLM call.

claims.text: We present Loom, a generative consensus framework deployed for real-world RCA that bridges these paradigms.
claims.support_span: We present Loom, a generative consensus framework deployed for real-world RCA that bridges these paradigms.

claims.text: Evaluated on the OpenRCA benchmark, Loom occupies the accuracy--efficiency Pareto frontier: it matches a state-of-the-art autonomous agent on Bank and Market-2 and trails on Market-1 and Telecom, while using a single LLM call per incident on all four datasets (~26× faster; ~33× with an 8B-parameter synthesizer).

items.title: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
items.one_liner: SafeEvolve aligns LLM agent safety through an experience-driven loop of runtime harness and policy co-evolution.
items.summary: SafeEvolve is an experience-driven self-evolving framework for LLM agent safety alignment that couples harness updates with policy optimization. By transforming completed on-policy trajectory safety evidence into bounded component-level updates across safety prompts and skills, the framework drives a continual loop of harness-policy co-evolution using a two-stage SFT-RL training paradigm. Experiments on agentic benchmarks show that SafeEvolve significantly improves safety-utility trade-offs, reducing the Attack Success Rate by 3x on AgentDojo for Qwen3.5-4B while increasing benign utility from 59.79 percent to 61.86 percent.
items.bottom_line: SafeEvolve achieves superior agent safety alignment by co-evolving runtime harnesses and policies using empirical execution trajectories.

items.title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents
items.one_liner: LoopHarness provides a persistent, non-decaying safety state across LLM agent loops to prevent multi-iteration fragmented attacks.
items.summary: Autonomous LLM agents operate in unattended loops across many iterations, but standard safeguards are defined over a single trajectory and re-initialized when a new trajectory begins. The authors show a theoretical separation: trajectory-scoped monitors fail against attacks whose evidence is fragmented across iterations, whereas a monitor retaining cross-iteration state succeeds. While geometrically decaying risk scores are insufficient due to fixed wait times, the authors introduce LoopHarness, which enforces a persistent, non-decaying safety state at the loop level. Under mediated commits and an arbiter detection floor, LoopHarness bounds unauthorized irreversible actions to a constant term, surviving fully colluding verifiers.
items.bottom_line: Trajectory-scoped monitors fail against multi-step attacks, requiring loop-level persistent state architectures to bound unauthorized actions.

items.title: FUSE: An Evaluating Framework for Dangerous Capabilities of LLMs
items.one_liner: Evaluate dangerous AI capabilities across Knowledge, Defense, and Harm pipelines using the modular FUSE framework.
